report_name: Faversham Town Council Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify current rates and estimate future demand for cycling based on commuting and school trips, providing both straight-line desire lines and applied networks to inform the LCWIP network recommendations.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool (RST) and Walking Route Assessment Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP methodology and prioritisation approach enabled Faversham Town Council, Swale Borough Council, and Kent County Council to secure £1 million in funding from Active Travel England, which was used to implement the East-West cross-town walking route.
pct_usage_quote: The PCT (www.pct.bike) shows current rates and estimates future demand for cycling based on commuting and school trips.
